devon_support: urgent: ACME tenant reported repeated 429s & latency spikes on Dedicated pool A. Symptoms look like KV eviction churn + auth retries. Customer says ~30% of requests returned 429 in last 15m. Can infra look?

lee_infra: on it — can you paste the tenant id and a sample log? Also did they change long_context setting?

devon_support: tenant=acme-prod-17. Logs (trimmed):
```
2026-03-17T08:12:05Z WARN kvcache: evict_rate=1450/s frag_ratio=0.78 tenant=acme-prod-17
2026-03-17T08:12:06Z ERROR inference: request=xyz status=429 reason=kv-miss-throttle
2026-03-17T08:12:09Z INFO autoscale: scale_up_blocked policy=burst_limit current_replicas=12
```
Repro: large batch job from tenant with long_context=64k went live ~08:10 and coincides.

nate_sre: ops-bot shows global kvcache_compaction not fired. Suspect memory fragmentation: many small KV entries causing slab fragmentation -> GC can't free continuous ranges -> evictions spike. Can you run `redwoodctl kvcache inspect --tenant acme-prod-17 --summary` and dump slab hist?

lee_infra: ran it, output:
```
slab_buckets: [8, 64, 256, 1024]
bucket_counts: [12043, 88712, 3124, 14]
free_frag_ratio: 0.81
compaction_last: 2026-03-15T23:48:11Z
```
Looks like tiny entries dominate and compaction hasn't run since yesterday.

ops-bot: ALERT kv-evict-rate HIGH on pool-dedicated-1 (host: rwd-d1-23) :rotating_light:

sarah_pm: customer impact? any billing/auth holes? We can't have repeated 429s and backfills.

devon_support: they're seeing spikes and retries cause duplicate token consumption. Billing shows a 2x token burst for the hour.

nate_sre: proposed mitigations (short-term):
- temp-route tenant to spare pool: `redwoodctl route set acme-prod-17 --pool spare-dedicated-2`
- throttle tenant long_context via `redwoodctl tenant update acme-prod-17 --kv-prefix-limit 512 --long-context-max 8192`
- trigger kvcache compaction: `redwoodctl kvcache compact --pool pool-dedicated-1 --force`

Longer-term:
- enable KV coalescing patch (v0.9.4) that merges adjacent small entries into slab
- tune slab allocator to bias larger buckets for LLM longctx workloads

lee_infra: executed compaction and set throttles. Routing change in progress, will confirm once traffic drains. Adding temporary canary for rollbacks.

devon_support: FYI customer accepted temp routing. I'll confirm with them and pause any non-critical batch jobs.

nate_sre: logging note for postmortem: capture per-tenant slab hist every 5m, add alert on free_frag_ratio > 0.7 + evict_rate > 500/s.

lee_infra: added alert rule and a runbook entry with commands used above. closing loop after 1h stable.

devon_support: thanks all :pray: I'll update the ticket and keep PMs posted.
